def: illumination or (concrete) luminary (in every sense, including lightning, happiness, etc.)
kjv: bright, clear, [phrase] day, light (-ning), morning, sun.

occurrences.text: And God said, Let there be light: and there was light.

words: And he shall be as the light

words: and upon whom doth not his light
